errors.evidence: The description does not mention units for the Y-axis in any of the panels.
The description claims there are no visible labels or units on the Y-axes, which is misleading since the axes have numerical scales.
The description reports a minimum of approximately -35 for the orange line in the left panel when it shows around -30.
The description states the Y-axis range for the left panel is from -40 to 20, while it actually ranges from approximately -30 to 20.
The description states the tick intervals for the middle panel are every 10, but the Y-axis values actually indicate different intervals.
